properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause), 2026-10-26, flo2 trial on a sample apartment building design (reflow2 0.92.0).

① OBSERVED: "record_change is named in reflow2's notes but refused by the chat door." NOT affected: the served skills and the served instructions.

② PRECEDENT: reflow2:dec:the-two-renamed-stubs-are-removed-in-the-next-release and reflow2:cap:the-two-renamed-stubs-are-removed (the removal itself); reflow2:fact:the-deprecation-announcement-check-fails-at-the-0-92-0-cut-because-two-stubs-name-0-91-0-whose-notes-never-announced-them-2026-10-26. No finding on prose still naming it.

③ CANDIDATES: (a) a served SKILL names it; (b) the served INSTRUCTIONS (AGENTS.md) name it; (c) runtime messages or schema descriptions in the binary name it; (d) OUTSIDE reflow2: flo2's catalog or door text names it; (e) the agent read an old note from the design itself (graph prose, which is data).

④–⑤ MEASURED in source at v0.92.0: (a) refuted: `git grep record_change v0.92.0 -- getting-started` (the embedded skills and the served AGENTS.md, build.rs kit_dir) finds nothing. (b) refuted (same grep; the repo-root AGENTS.md mentions it at lines 893 and 1171, but that file is not the served one). (c) holds: edge_prose.rs:186 "`record_change` before an edit is what captures the prior state this reads" (a coverage_note propagate_change attaches as stale_edge_evidence for every seed with no prior snapshot; the trial ran it on 35 seeds, which makes this the likeliest one the agent met); detect.rs:6914 (the change-axis gap: "State it with `subject` on record_change or add_change_event"); hierarchy.rs:652; temporal.rs:1031 (the planned-epoch refusal: "Call record_change against ... first"); schema/temporal.yaml's DesignEpoch.status description. (d) refuted: flo2 origin/main refuses both names at the door and its tests assert they are gone (the-gateway-in-front-of-reflow2-0920.test.ts). (e) cannot be excluded: the trial design holds older prose.

⑥ CLASS: a removal checked by the tool list and the changelog, with the tool's name left in prose the binary serves. The same check would have caught manual_work_report (not grepped here).

RECOMMENDED, by correctness: (1) replace each message with snapshot_before_change (same arguments); (2) a test that no served string (every tool description, schema description, and every message a fixture run emits) names a tool absent from tools/list and not in the deprecation registry: it fails today on these five. 

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: which of the texts the trial agent actually read (its reply was not kept). Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
